plan_publication_consistent.name: plan_publication_consistent
plan_publication_consistent.value: ("plans"."status" = 'draft' AND "plans"."approvedByMemberId" IS NULL AND "plans"."publishedAt" IS NULL) OR ("plans"."status" = 'published' AND "plans"."approvedByMemberId" IS NOT NULL AND "plans"."publishedAt" IS NOT NULL)

task_acceptance_consistent.name: task_acceptance_consistent
task_acceptance_consistent.value: ("tasks"."status" = 'done' AND "tasks"."acceptedSubmissionId" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."acceptedByMemberId" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."acceptedAt" IS NOT NULL) OR ("tasks"."status" <> 'done' AND "tasks"."acceptedSubmissionId" IS NULL AND "tasks"."acceptedByMemberId" IS NULL AND "tasks"."acceptedAt" IS NULL)
